title: 美财长：霍尔木兹海峡即将重新开放
summary: 贝森特周二称，与伊朗的谈判仍在进行中，有可能“在今天或明天达成协议”。据悉伊朗与阿曼已商定管理海峡航运的临时安排。

title: 想要開放霍爾木茲海峽 伊朗向特朗普提出的六個條件
summary: 伊朗和阿曼都表示，關於重新開放霍爾木茲海峽的談判進展「積極」，但現在伊朗已向美國提出了一系列要求。

title: 霍爾木茲海峽：阿曼稱會談進展順利，伊朗則警告協議不會打通海峽
summary: 雙方均表示，在就開闢一條穿越海峽的新航線進行談判方面取得了進展，但能否取得突破仍不明朗。

title: 美军就要“弹尽炮绝”？
summary: 路透社独家援引美军武库知情人士报道说，美国在新近的中东伊朗冲突中，已消耗大部分高精度远程导弹库存。该消息引发了外界对美军应对未来冲突准备状态的担忧。特朗普对此类表述表达“很生气”，并威胁“严惩传播这些言论的叛徒”。

title: Houthi attacks reportedly kill at least 30 Yemeni government forces
summary: The Houthis say they launched missiles and drones at "Saudi military build-ups" in the central provinces of Marib and Hadramawt.

title: Threat to oil tankers in Middle East  worst since start of Iran war, analysts say
summary: Fresh attacks on alternative shipping routes have left tankers facing an increasingly complex situation, analysts say.

title: At least 13 killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza after Hamas agree disarmament deal
summary: Israel says it was targeting military operatives in the strikes on Gaza City, Khan Younis and Deir el-Balah.

title: Trump cancels Iran strikes subject to deal being made 'rapidly'
summary: The US president claims Iran and other Middle Eastern countries asked Washington to hold off on any attack as the "perimeters" of a deal had been agreed.

title: Israel strikes south Lebanon after two soldiers killed by explosion
summary: Lebanese authorities says one person was killed in the strikes, which came after the first Israeli military fatalities in Lebanon in more than a month.

title: Saudi Arabia's dilemma as it tries to stay out of US-Iran war
summary: The kingdom faces a choice of whether to keep hitting back as a deterrent or to try to de-escalate the situation.
